lessons.why: restart after an end before thinking_aloud-08

turns.teacherReply: Namaste Kabir, main Arjun, aapka AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions multiply karenge—football passes jaisa. Aapko fractions mein kya aata hai?

ask.text: Aapko fractions mein kya aata hai?

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, football field ka 3/4 hissa wet hai; us wet part ka 2/3 training ke liye chuna. Aap kitna field choose karenge? At the end, aap Bittu ko sikhaayenge.

move.shape: open with one concrete everyday situation built on their interest (football) — kit contexts: recipes and rotis, sharing cake and pizza, farm field fractions; ask what they think will happen or which they would pick — a prediction, no right answer yet; any bigger/more comparison: two quantities of one kind, in one unit — a count against a count, a distance against a distance; never across kinds; mention once: at the end they will teach this to Bittu (a pretend new student who missed this class); address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.childText: 1/2 ko 1/2 se guna karein toh chhota kyun ho jaata hai?
turns.teacherReply: Kabir, 1/2 ka 1/2 matlab aadhe ka aadha: pehle field aadha, phir uska aadha. Picture mein 4 equal parts mein 1 part bachta. Aap fraction bataaiye.

move.shape: one idea only: Multiply a whole number by a fraction and find a fraction of a quantity; an example from their interest (football) if it fits naturally; objects first, then a picture, then the symbol; point at the whiteboard anchor; end with one small question that makes them USE the idea — never 'samjha?'; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, agar cake ka 2/5 hissa aur uska 3/4 lena ho, “of” ka matlab multiply hoga: 2/5 × 3/4. Ab numerators aur denominators alag-alag multiply kijiye.

move.shape: worked example, part 1 of 2: say one step, then ask them for the next step; their thinking, your pace; no new idea; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

ask.text: Ab numerators aur denominators alag-alag multiply kijiye.

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, 4/7 of 3/5 nikaalte waqt pehle numerators, phir denominators multiply kijiye. Ab aap dono products bataaiye.

move.shape: worked example, part 2 of 2: say one step, then ask them for the next step; their thinking, your pace; no new idea; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, ab practice: 20 ka 1/4 nikaaliye. Hint: 20 ko 4 equal parts mein baantkar ek part sochiye. 20 ka 1/4 nikaaliye.

move.shape: pose the question as written, in their language; then wait; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, 7 likhna step mein toot gaya: 1/4 ka matlab 20 ko 4 barabar parts mein baantna. 20 ka 1/4 nikaaliye.

move.shape: rung 1 of 4 (pump): What does 1/4 of something mean?; the key stays unsaid; their answer was not right: no agreement or praise word for it; name what is sensible in it, then the step; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, aapne 20 ko 4 equal parts mein baantkar 5 paaya—yeh exact step sahi hai. 12 × 1/3, 12 se bada hai ya chhota?

move.shape: confirm specifically: name the exact thing they got right, no ability words; pose the question as written, in their language; then wait; read its choices plainly; no lean in your voice toward any of them; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.teacherReply: Aap dono choices picture kijiye. 12 × 1/3, 12 se bada hai ya chhota?

move.shape: rung 1 of 4 (pump): ask them to picture both choices as real things; the key stays unsaid; no verdict on their reply: neither praise nor 'wrong'; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

hint.text: Picture each choice as real things.

turns.teacherReply: Kabir, aapne 12 ko 3 equal parts mein baantkar 4 paaya—isi method se 3 × 2/5 nikaaliye. Try kijiye. 3 × 2/5 nikaaliye.

move.shape: confirm specifically: name the exact thing they got right, no ability words; pose the question as written, in their language; then wait; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu

turns.childText: kuch samajh nahi aa raha, chhodo
turns.teacherReply: Theek hai Kabir, yahin rok dete hain. Aap jab chahein, fractions ko picture se phir dekhenge. Goodbye, apna dhyaan rakhiye!

move.shape: they want to stop: stop now; short warm goodbye; nothing left hanging; address them with aap forms only (aap, aapka, aapne; verbs -iye / -enge), never tum or tu
